primary_sources.role: Reward-aware A/B test sizing is established prior work. Treat our empirical prior and delayed-feedback comparisons as an application and robustness study.
Summarized bandit histories and LLM exploration failures are established.
Tool-supported non-reasoning LLMs and comparisons against simple estimators are established. A tool benefit by itself is insufficient novelty.
SAE downstream comparisons require strong dense and random controls.
Random-direction/pattern controls can match trained SAEs. Our article-level threshold control must not be described as an exact token-level replication.

candidate_contributions_to_test: Matched-layer SAE versus dense/random representations in sequential recommendation with article turnover, strictly unseen article IDs, and clean simulator families.
Feature interventions reconstructed from the actual pre-action UCB state, separating score-level sensitivity, retraining compensation, and semantic label transfer.
Paired separation of optional tool invocation, displayed posterior statistics, headline priors, and feedback timing in low-CTR news decisions.
novelty_status: Scoped empirical extension: matched-layer sequential MIND comparisons with width/selection controls, state-faithful policy interventions, and direct-estimator controls for tools. The general SAE utility gap and LLM exploration/tool effects are established in prior work. No new-algorithm or first-of-its-kind claim is made.
adaptive_decisions: Report every prespecified sensitivity condition, including reversals and inconclusive results.
Do not increase sample size solely to obtain a significance threshold.
Consider in-domain relabeling only if the held-out semantic matching test identifies a concrete external-label transfer failure.
Consider semantic steering only if trained features show reproducible semantic alignment beyond label-shuffling controls.
If trained SAEs appear to outperform the 128-direction random controls, add a width/selection-matched random-feature control before attributing the advantage to learned features.
If a tool-assisted LLM clearly improves over the strongest direct statistics/prior baseline, isolate posterior means from uncertainty fields before making a component-specific causal claim.
completed_validation_scope: Compare representation utility and automated semantic specificity in matched article-turnover streams, including strictly excluded IDs and alternate response simulators.
Separate local UCB decision sensitivity, retraining necessity, subset sufficiency, and semantic retrieval using actual pre-action states.
Compare fresh Gemma/Qwen agents with direct posterior policies, training-derived priors, and every planned Gemma ablation on a common legacy response bank.

last_targeted_search.interpretation: Results were broad and did not establish a directly matching study. Search absence is not evidence of priority.

additional_experiment_decision_after_com: No additional run is required by the identified validity issues. Width matching, strict article IDs, alternate-teacher transfer, state reconstruction, semantic noise controls and numerical agent baselines are complete. No agent shows a resolved improvement over direct posterior-mean choice; the conditional component-isolation follow-up is not triggered. Inconclusive ablations remain inconclusive.
